feat: add TLS certificate trust feature with comprehensive e2e tests

This commit implements complete TLS certificate trust functionality:

- Add pkg/trust package with LoadPool() and NewHTTP() functions
- Support --cacert and --capath CLI flags with SSL_CERT_FILE/SSL_CERT_DIR env vars
- Integrate custom HTTP client globally via api.SetHTTPClient()
- Add proper error handling with helpful user messages

- TestTLSInvalidCertFile: validates error when --cacert points to invalid file
- TestTLSUntrustedCert: tests connection behavior with untrusted certificates
- TestTLSTrustedCert: validates successful connection with trusted CA via --cacert

- Generate self-signed test certificates (ca.pem, server.crt, server.key)
- Add MockArgoServerHTTPS() for HTTPS test servers with custom certificates
- Add WriteArgoConfigHTTPS() helpers for TLS-enabled ArgoCD configs
- Extend existing e2e framework to support TLS scenarios

The implementation provides portable custom trust for ArgoCD connections while maintaining clean architecture, comprehensive testing, and secure defaults (TLS 1.2+, proper certificate validation).
